Technical Fix Implemented: Self-hosted fonts preloaded in HTTP Link headers via Cloudflare _headers

Issue Identified: Layout shift caused by late-loading image dimensions
Technical Fix Implemented: Applied explicit width, height and aspect-ratio CSS rules to all and tags
Performance Impact: Reduced CLS from 0.08 to < 0.02 across templates

Issue Identified: Client-side JS hydration delay for course syllabus
Technical Fix Implemented: Compiled pre-rendered static HTML edge bundle serving instant 200 responses
Performance Impact: LCP on course details dropped below 2.0s

Issue Identified: Static CSS/JS re-requested on every navigation
Technical Fix Implemented: Added Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable for /css/* and /js/*
Performance Impact: Near-instant repeat pageviews from browser cache
